notes.organization: Admin APIs - not typically needed for client usage

CreateResponse.note: Spec uses allOf — verifier cannot extract top-level properties. GPT-5.6 sync: prompt_cache_options (PromptCacheOptionsParam) and beta multi_agent (BetaMultiAgentParam, from BetaCreateResponse) added.

Response.note: Spec uses allOf — verifier cannot extract top-level properties. GPT-5.6 sync: prompt_cache_options (PromptCacheOptions echo) added.

ResponsesClientEventResponseCreate.note: Realtime client event embedding CreateResponse; constructed inline by the realtime resource.

PersonalityEnum.note: Open string enum (anyOf string | {friendly, pragmatic}) modeled as a sealed union with friendly/pragmatic variants plus a custom string variant.

PersonalityEnum:CustomPersonality.note: Dart-only open string variant for forward-compatible/custom values.

TokenCountsBody.note: Request body built inline in InputTokensResource.count() (no request model). personality field added.

Item.note: Sealed parent union of input items with untracked variants (matches ConversationItem/OutputItem). AdditionalToolsItemParam variant added. GPT-5.6 sync: program/program_output (ProgramItem/ProgramOutputItem) and beta multi-agent agent_message/multi_agent_call/multi_agent_call_output variants added; caller (ToolCallCaller) added to function/custom tool call items; nullable agent (AgentTag) added to all variants with beta multi-agent twins.

ItemField.note: Orphan spec union unreferenced by any endpoint; shares the OutputItem shape. AdditionalTools variant added.

AdditionalTools.note: Output/conversation item variant of the skip parent unions OutputItem/ItemResource/ConversationItem; also implemented as ConversationAdditionalToolsItem.

AdditionalToolsItemParam.note: Input item variant of the skip parent union Item.

AuditLog.note: Admin API audit-log schema, excluded from coverage (excluded_tags: Administration). Not implemented.

AuditLogEventType.note: Admin API audit-log enum, excluded from coverage (excluded_tags: Administration). Not implemented.

AdminApiKey.note: Admin API key schema, excluded from coverage (excluded_tags: Administration). Not implemented.

AdminApiKeyCreateResponse.note: Admin API key creation response, excluded from coverage (excluded_tags: Administration). Not implemented.

Reasoning.note: Implemented (not codegen-tracked) as ReasoningConfig; context added. GPT-5.6 sync: mode (ReasoningModeEnum) added.

MCPTool.note: Implemented (not codegen-tracked) as McpTool (a ResponseTool variant); tunnel_id + connector_id added, server_url now optional. GPT-5.6 sync: allowed_callers added.

CreateChatCompletionRequest.note: Spec uses allOf — verifier cannot extract top-level properties. Missing copyWith.

CreateChatCompletionResponse.note: Missing copyWith. Has extra non-spec field (provider) for OpenRouter compat.

ChatCompletionRequestMessage.note: Spec schema is a oneOf discriminated union, not a verifiable object. Already tracked as sealed_parent via ChatMessage entry.

CreateImageRequest.note: Missing copyWith. Spec has many new fields (output_format, stream, moderation, background) not yet in Dart.

CreateSpeechRequest.note: Missing copyWith. Spec has new fields (instructions, stream_format) not yet in Dart.

CreateTranscriptionRequest.note: Missing copyWith. Spec has many new fields (include, stream, chunking_strategy, etc.) not yet in Dart.

RunObject.note: Many spec-required fields are intentionally nullable in Dart (required_action, last_error, expires_at, started_at, etc.) because the API returns null for these depending on run state.

CompletionUsage.note: completionTokens is nullable for provider compat but spec requires non-null. toString missing promptTokensDetails/completionTokensDetails.

ChatCompletionRequestFunctionMessage.note: Deprecated in spec. The 'function' role is superseded by 'tool' messages. Not implemented in Dart.

ChatStreamEvent.note: Not a sealed class in Dart (plain class). No spec schema. All required spec fields are nullable for provider compat. Has extra provider field for OpenRouter.

CreateChatCompletionStreamResponse.note: Dart uses ChatStreamEvent (plain class) instead of separate ChatStreamChunk subclass. Required spec fields (id, choices, created, model, object) are nullable for provider compat.

TextResponseFormatJsonSchema.note: Shares discriminator value 'json_schema' with ResponseFormatJsonSchema. Both handled by JsonSchemaResponseFormat. TextResponseFormatJsonSchema has flat properties while ResponseFormatJsonSchema nests under json_schema key.

ResponseProperties.note: Spec helper schema; properties inlined on CreateResponse and Response. max_output_tokens, reasoning, and truncation moved to inline.

ToolChoice.note: Uses string values ('auto', 'none', 'required') or object with type field for function/allowed_tools/custom choice

ChatCompletionNamedToolChoice.note: toJson() returns Object instead of Map<String, dynamic> because parent sealed class uses string values for other variants. Verifier cannot inspect non-Map toJson.

ChatCompletionAllowedToolsChoice.note: toJson() returns Object instead of Map<String, dynamic> because parent sealed class uses string values for other variants. Verifier cannot inspect non-Map toJson.

ChatCompletionNamedToolChoiceCustom.note: toJson() returns Object instead of Map<String, dynamic> because parent sealed class uses string values for other variants. Verifier cannot inspect non-Map toJson.

MessageContent.note: Message content for Assistants API threads (not to be confused with chat messages)

ChatModel.note: Package uses String for model IDs, not an enum type.

ClickParam.note: Spec ClickParam maps to Dart ClickAction. Keys property added.

ComputerCallOutputStatus.note: Spec enum maps to existing ItemStatus enum with same values.

ComputerToolCallOutputResource.note: Spec resource maps to Dart ComputerCallOutputItem. createdBy added.

ConversationItem.note: Sealed parent with different naming convention. CompactionBody variant added.

CreateVideoCharacterBody.note: Multipart upload deferred; not currently implemented in VideosResource.

CreateVideoEditJsonBody.note: Spec JSON body maps to Dart CreateVideoEditRequest.

CreateVideoEditMultipartBody.note: Multipart variant deferred; JSON variant covers primary use case.

CreateVideoExtendJsonBody.note: Spec JSON body maps to Dart CreateVideoExtendRequest.

CreateVideoExtendMultipartBody.note: Multipart variant deferred; JSON variant covers primary use case.

CreateVideoJsonBody.note: Spec JSON body maps to Dart CreateVideoRequest. inputReference added.

CreateVideoMultipartBody.note: Multipart variant deferred; JSON variant covers primary use case.

CustomToolCallOutputResource.note: Spec resource maps to Dart CustomToolCallOutputItem.

CustomToolCallResource.note: Spec resource maps to Dart CustomToolCallItem.

DragParam.note: Spec DragParam maps to Dart DragAction. Keys property added.

FileDetailEnum.note: Identical to FileInputDetail; single Dart enum serves both schemas.

FileInputDetail.note: Enum co-located in input_content.dart with InputFileContent. GPT-5.6 sync: auto value added.

FunctionToolCallOutputResource.note: Spec resource maps to existing Dart type. createdBy added.

FunctionToolCallResource.note: Spec resource maps to existing function call output item. createdBy added.

InputFileContent.note: Manual class with detail property. Serves both InputFileContent and InputFileContentParam roles.

InputFileContentParam.note: No separate Param class; InputFileContent serves both roles.

ItemResource.note: Sealed parent union of output items. Custom tool variants added.

MoveParam.note: Spec MoveParam maps to Dart MoveAction. Keys property added.

OutputItem.note: Sealed parent. Custom tool variants added. GPT-5.6 sync: program/program_output (ProgramOutputItemResponse/ProgramOutputResultItem) and beta multi-agent agent_message/multi_agent_call/multi_agent_call_output variants added; caller (ToolCallCaller) added to function/custom tool call items; nullable agent (AgentTag) added to all variants with beta multi-agent twins; caller added to shell_call/shell_call_output.

ScrollParam.note: Spec ScrollParam maps to Dart ScrollAction. Keys property added.

VideoCharacterResource.note: Spec resource maps to Dart VideoCharacter.

VideoReferenceInputParam.note: Video ID passed as String in request types, no separate class.

VoiceIdsOrCustomVoice.note: Deferred. Current voice enums sufficient for known voice IDs.

Message.note: Maps to multiple Dart classes: MessageItem (responses input), MessageOutputItem (responses output), ConversationMessageItem (conversations). Not a single verifiable object.

OAuthErrorCode.note: Orphan schema used only on OAuthError exception in Python SDK. No endpoint or request/response model references it. OAuth error handling not yet in Dart.

PromptCacheRetentionEnum.note: Spec inconsistency: this named enum uses 'in_memory' (underscore) but the inline ModelResponseProperties.prompt_cache_retention used by chat/responses still uses 'in-memory' (hyphen). The Dart PromptCacheRetention enum maps inMemory -> 'in-memory'; CompactResponseRequest serializes/deserializes 'in_memory' explicitly to bridge the gap. Marked skip to avoid verifier flagging the value mismatch.

PromptCacheTTLEnum.note: Wire value '30m' is the minutes30 member. Also covers identical Beta twin.

PromptCacheOptions.note: Response echo (mode/ttl required). Also covers identical Beta twin.

PromptCacheOptionsParam.note: Request param (mode/ttl optional). Also covers identical Beta twin.

PromptCacheBreakpointConfig.note: Single const field mode='explicit' (getter). One class serves PromptCacheBreakpointConfig, PromptCacheBreakpointParam, and Beta twins.

ReasoningModeEnum.note: Open string enum (anyOf string | {standard, pro}) modeled as a sealed union with standard/pro variants plus a custom string variant, following Personality. Also covers identical BetaReasoningModeEnum.

ToolCallCaller.note: Also covers structurally identical ToolCallCallerParam and Beta twins.

DirectToolCallCaller.note: Also covers DirectToolCallCallerParam and Beta twins.

ProgramToolCallCaller.note: Also covers ProgramToolCallCallerParam and Beta twins.

ProgramOutputStatus.note: Also covers identical ProgramOutputItemStatus and Beta twins.

BetaMultiAgentParam.note: Multi-agent beta config; set via CreateResponseRequest.multiAgent with beta: true on the resource call.

BetaResponseInjectEvent.note: Beta multi-agent WebSocket protocol event; no HTTP path in spec, no transport wired (data model only).

BetaResponseInjectCreatedEvent.note: Beta multi-agent WebSocket protocol event; data model only.

BetaResponseInjectFailedEvent.note: Beta multi-agent WebSocket protocol event; data model only. Inline error object modeled as ResponseInjectError + ResponseInjectErrorCode.
